reviews.text: Amazing professionalism! Quickly saw a different issue leaning on house from a storm, and removed tree, then addressed other matter. And both for a fantastic price. Pat is your tree service person! Don't choose anyone else.
reviews.author: Thunder B.

reviews.text: Patrick did an amazing job with this tree by shaping up and trimming I was wanting to take it down but his suggestion on keeping it and just making it look good was the correct way to go. A great professional and pleasant even in 100 degree weather.
reviews.author: Diane S.

reviews.text: We highly recommend PK Leaves & Patrick for your tree trimming, storm clean up and small/mid size tree removal needs. He is a very hard worker and truly cares about the job he does. His pricing is fair and reasonable.
reviews.author: Lindsey C.
